name: Full-Stack Development
description: Web application development from semantic HTML/CSS/JavaScript through a frontend framework, REST APIs, databases, authentication, testing, and basic deployment. Tunisian academic anchors include Programmation orientée objet, Bases de données, Génie logiciel and Systèmes d'exploitation.

name: Cloud Engineering
description: Operating and automating cloud infrastructure: Linux/CLI, networking, cloud compute/storage/identity, Infrastructure as Code, containers, CI/CD and monitoring. Tunisian academic anchors include Réseaux informatiques, Systèmes d'exploitation and Architecture des ordinateurs.

name: Machine Learning
description: Data-driven predictive modeling: linear algebra and probability/statistics foundations, Python/NumPy, classical supervised learning, evaluation, feature engineering, and introductory deep learning. This field emphasizes model building rather than dashboard/reporting work.

name: Data Analysis & Data Science
description: Turning structured data into reliable analysis and business communication: SQL/Python, cleaning with pandas, descriptive and inferential statistics, visualization, BI/dashboarding, and data storytelling. It deliberately stops short of making ML model training the core competency.
